scope.name: Happy Desktop development client main window — light

claims.subject: desktop application shell
claims.observation: The captured Happy shell has a persistent left navigation region and a separate main canvas under native macOS window chrome.

claims.subject: left navigation region
claims.observation: The visible divider is approximately 295 pt from the left edge in this persisted runtime state.
limitations: Happy persists a resizable panel width, so this runtime value is not necessarily the product default.

claims.subject: sidebar leading controls
claims.observation: The visible sidebar begins with New Session and archive controls followed by Todo; it has no visible product header, global search, notification control, or Codex-like global destination family.

claims.subject: sidebar session rows
claims.observation: Visible session rows commonly expose title, runtime state, branch or worktree, machine, and project metadata across multiple lines; the captured list is grouped primarily by activity period rather than the Codex project-first hierarchy.

claims.subject: main content region
claims.observation: The main content region is visually blank in the captured state even though active sessions are visible in the sidebar.
limitations: The capture does not establish whether no session route was selected, the route was still loading, or a runtime defect prevented content from rendering. It is not evidence about the normal conversation layout.

claims.subject: conversation, tool, and composer runtime appearance
claims.observation: The captured state does not expose conversation, tool, approval, diff, or composer surfaces, so current runtime parity for those regions cannot be judged from this screenshot.
limitations: After the app was restarted, macOS continued to report Screen Recording authorization but window-specific capture returned `could not create image from window`; Computer Use also returned `cgWindowNotFound` for this Tauri app.

evidence.notes: Lossless named-window capture. Private session labels remain outside Git.
CGWindow geometry, image dimensions, scale estimate, and checksum.
Current Happy source for leading controls, Session list host, and Settings footer.
Current Happy source for flat and machine/project/session list shapes.
The first worktree-bundle frame was captured before the web content became usable; later named-window capture attempts failed and are treated as blocked evidence, not as a product baseline.

limitations: Only one light main-window shell state is usable as a baseline.
The main conversation region is absent from the captured state.
Persisted panel width means the measured sidebar is a runtime state, not a default-token claim.
Current post-restart window capture is temporarily unavailable despite authorized Screen Recording.

notes: Consumer baseline for the Codex-first Happy workflow. Product adoption decisions live in the workflow specification and deviation ledger.
